# Public vector fixture

`shortbread-rouen.pbf` is tile XYZ 13/4121/2797 (TMS row 5394), extracted
from https://download.geofabrik.de/europe/france/haute-normandie-shortbread-1.0.mbtiles
on 2026-11-12. Public map data: OpenStreetMap contributors, prepared by Geofabrik,
Shortbread 1.0 schema. This is a synthetic test location, with no device trace.

Used to check actual schema/style compatibility, dictionary merging and rendered
pixels with a memory provider and no network tile source.
